note: Service: Law No. 665 of 4 February 2005 cut the 'flag service' to six months and invalidated it two years after publication; the Army Command announced, per the National News Agency, that military service was completely cancelled from 10 February 2007. Read from the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada's response LBN103352.E of 21 January 2010, which quotes the law from the Lebanese Army's site (lebarmy.gov.lb, whose pages now answer 404; archive.org snapshots of March 2026 exist but couldn't be fetched). A later parliamentary committee approval of a draft conscription bill (L'Orient-Le Jour, found by search, not read) isn't law as far as was found; not modelled. Majority and work: the Labour Code (as amended by Law 536 of 1996) and the Code of Obligations and Contracts weren't read (the Ministry of Labour's site is behind Cloudflare, the Lebanese University database didn't answer, the NDU copy is gone); left null.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada: Lebanon, the date the law abolishing compulsory military service came into effect (LBN103352.E, 21 January 2010)
sources.said: "Military Service shall be completely cancelled as of 10 February 2007 in accordance with Law No. 665/2005"
